description: This source file implements parsing functions for X.509 certificates, including parsing of certificate structure, extensions, validity, and related components, following RFC 5280 standards.

classes.name: ParsedTbsCertificate
classes.description: Structure holding parsed components of a TBSCertificate.

classes.name: ParsedExtension
classes.description: Structure representing a parsed certificate extension.

classes.name: ParsedDistributionPoint
classes.description: Structure representing a parsed distribution point.

classes.name: ParsedAuthorityKeyIdentifier
classes.description: Structure for parsed Authority Key Identifier extension.

methods.name: ParseCertificate
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded X.509 certificate into its components.

methods.name: ParseTbsCertificate
methods.description: Parses the TBSCertificate part of an X.509 certificate.

methods.name: ParseExtensions
methods.description: Parses a sequence of extensions from DER data.

methods.name: ParseExtension
methods.description: Parses a single extension from DER data.

methods.name: ParseAuthorityKeyIdentifier
methods.description: Parses the Authority Key Identifier extension.

methods.name: ParseSubjectKeyIdentifier
methods.description: Parses the Subject Key Identifier extension.

methods.name: ParseAuthorityInfoAccessURIs
methods.description: Extracts URIs from Authority Information Access extension.

methods.name: VerifySerialNumber
methods.description: Validates the serial number of a certificate.

methods.name: ParseValidity
methods.description: Parses the validity period of a certificate.

methods.name: ParseVersion
methods.description: Parses the version number of a certificate.

methods.name: ParseAndAddDistributionPoint
methods.description: Parses and adds a distribution point to a list.

methods.name: ConsumeExtension
methods.description: Removes a specific extension from a set of unconsumed extensions.
